_doc: Placement problem for `copperpath place --zones` (written by a person or an AI agent).
movable / fixed: reference wildcards or sheet:<sheet name>. Parts not listed as movable stay.
zones[]: refs, rect [x0,y0,x1,y1] or poly [[x,y],...], side F/B/FB, rot_step (deg, 0 = keep),
rot_pref (deg list), near {ref, pin, max} (hard distance limit in mm), why (free text).
eval_region + via_class: where free via sites of that class count in the cost.
init: keep | schematic | both. weights: hpwl, cross, via, cong, loop_, len, exit, pref, near, diag.
loop_nets: net wildcards whose length is weighted extra. moves: per start. seed: RNG seed.

zones.why: driver block stays between controller and outputs
